title: Feed Scout routes book-summary sources into skill workflow extraction
query: Run a dry pass over a configured YouTube channel and blog list that often post business-book summaries. Several new items look like summaries with key takeaways and exercises. What should the scout do before creating proposals?
reference_points: Keeps the run explicit or dry-run and does not start a daemon, background crawler, live spend, or unapproved Notion write
Normalizes and dedupes discovered videos/articles before extraction
Uses summarize for transcripts, articles, and linked summary-source extraction
Extracts workflow-shaped takeaway signals such as triggers, steps, decision points, exercises, prompts, outputs, and proof ideas instead of producing generic book recaps
Compares related summary sources when available and labels convergence or uncertainty before proposing a skill change
Routes reusable skill behavior to skill-creator's book-summary branch, broader harness techniques to harness-scout, repeated patterns to best-of-worlds, and weak recaps to ledger-only status
notes: Guards the new route where feeds of book-summary videos/articles become skill workflow candidates rather than plain content summaries.
